name: Names of the Nameless
description: The voices of the nameless dead intrude into the minds of the living.
disable: DC 26 Perception to discern a name spoken by the nameless dead, or DC 28 Religion (expert) to put the nameless dead to rest. Speaking three names aloud disables the haunt. A creature that speaks any other name aloud must succeed at a DC 28 Will Saving Throw save or be Confused for 1 round.
reset: If the haunt is disabled, divine light washes through the area. Living creatures in the area regain 4d8 Healing Damage Hit Points, and undead creatures in the area take 4d8 Vitality Damage damage. The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the area but resets immediately thereafter.
routine: (1 action; auditory, divine, emotion, fear, mental) Spirits of the dead whisper their names into the minds of creatures in the room, dealing (2d10+11) Mental Damage damage (Basic DC 28 Will Saving Throw save). A creature that fails the save is also Frightened 1 (or Frightened 2 on a critical failure).

generalAbilities.name: Disappearing Door
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature enters the room

Effect An illusory wall appears across the room's entrance. A creature who succeeds at DC 30 Perception check disbelieves the illusion, allowing them to leave the area. The haunt then rolls initiative.
